caption: Moses Harris, Prismatic Colour Wheel, from The Natural System of Colours (1766)
alt: A hand-coloured colour wheel headed “Prismatic”: wedges of graded colour running from red through orange, yellow, green and blue to purple, around a white disc holding red, yellow and blue triangles that overlap in black.
bibliography: Harris, Moses. Prismatic Colour Wheel. The Natural System of Colours, 1766, Royal Academy of Arts, London.
title: Prismatic Colour Wheel
